    Written guides

    Every symptom, with causes and fixes

    Drivetrain

    • Robot drifts or curves when driving straight
    • Strafing is wrong — it spins, goes diagonal, or barely moves
    • Controls are backwards or mixed up
    • Robot moves on its own
    • Drivetrain is slow or weak

    Connection

    • Robot disconnects or loses the Driver Station mid-match
    • Driver Station won't connect to the robot at all
    • Gamepad doesn't respond or buttons are wrong

    Power & wiring

    • Robot loses power or reboots when things run
    • Battery dies fast or shows low voltage

    Mechanisms

    • A motor won't spin
    • Slides or arm sag, slip, or won't hold
    • Arm or slide shakes, overshoots, or runs away
    • Chain or belt skips or falls off
    • Something works, then loosens or slips over time

    Servos

    • Servo doesn't move
    • Servo jitters, buzzes, or twitches
    • Servo doesn't reach full range or the right angle

    Code & OpModes

    • Error: "Unable to find a hardware device"
    • OpMode crashes with an error
    • Robot won't stop when I press STOP
    • OpMode doesn't show up on the Driver Station
    • Can't deploy code from Android Studio
    • Controls feel laggy or the loop is slow

    Sensors & odometry

    • Encoder reads 0, jumps, or counts wrong
    • IMU heading is wrong or field-centric is broken
    • Odometry / Pinpoint position is wrong or drifts

    Vision

    • AprilTags aren't detected or are unreliable
    • Camera or Limelight isn't detected

    Autonomous

    • Autonomous is different every run
    • Path follower overshoots, oscillates, or runs away
